name: half-kneeling-banded-external-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume a half kneeling position with your elbow and shoulder flexed to 90 degrees laterally while holding a band with a pronated grip.
2. Rotate directly at the shoulder while keeping the elbow bent until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor.
3. Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
